title: Did You Miss These Automotive Legends? Shop Press Automotive Paragons Series: Recapped
summary: Designs, technologies, and inventions that changed history, all right here on Shop Press. The post Did You Miss These Automotive Legends? Shop Press Automotive Paragons Series: Recapped appeared first on Shop Press .
body_markdown:
As the longest-running article series here on Shop Press, the Automotive Paragons stories pay tribute to icons of the industry and transformative movers, shakers, and thinkers of the automotive world. As we continue adding to the series, we’ll also give a quick recap now and then in case you’ve missed some of these in-depth profiles. Here’s our list of Paragons pieces published[since our last recap](https://shoppress.dormanproducts.com/automotive-paragons-recap/) . As always, thanks for reading!


### Virgil Exner: The Creator of Chrysler’s “Forward Look” by Jonathan Roth


Virgil Exner helped redefine automotive styling during the 1950s with Chrysler’s famous “Forward Look” design language. His sleek, low-slung cars and dramatic tailfins helped Chrysler shake off a reputation for plain-jane styling and leap to the front of the industry. In this piece, learn how Exner’s vision transformed automotive aesthetics and influenced an entire generation of American cars.


[Read Article](https://shoppress.dormanproducts.com/virgil-exner-forward-look/)


### The Folded Paper Era and Beyond: Giorgetto Giugiaro’s Iconic Design Journey by Evan Griffey


Easily one of the most influential automotive designers of all time, Giorgetto Giugiaro’s work spans everything from exotic supercars to practical commuter vehicles. If you’ve ever admired the sharp, timeless lines of the Lotus Esprit, Volkswagen Golf, DeLorean DMC-12, or countless other iconic vehicles, you’ve seen Giugiaro’s influence firsthand. This article examines the designer’s remarkable career and the lasting impact of his distinctive “folded paper” styling philosophy.


[Read Article](https://shoppress.dormanproducts.com/giorgetto-giugiaro/)


### Colin Chapman: The Philosopher of Motion (Parts 1 & 2) by Evan Griffey


Few figures have influenced motorsports engineering as profoundly as Colin Chapman. The founder of Lotus embraced a philosophy that remains famous today: simplify, then add lightness. In this two-part series, we follow Chapman’s journey from building trials cars in a London garage to revolutionizing Formula One through innovative chassis designs, aerodynamics, and engineering concepts that forever changed racing.


[Read Article - Part 1](https://shoppress.dormanproducts.com/colin-chapman-part-1/)


[Read Article - Part 2](https://shoppress.dormanproducts.com/colin-chapman-part-2/)


### Sergio Pininfarina: Sculpting Speed and Beauty in Metal (Parts 1 & 2) by Evan Griffey


The Pininfarina name has become synonymous with beautiful automobiles, but Sergio Pininfarina did far more than simply oversee the creation of stunning cars. Under his leadership, the Pininfarina design house forged legendary partnerships with Ferrari and other automakers while helping define what automotive elegance would look like for decades. This two-part article traces Sergio’s life and career, examining how his influence shaped some of the most admired vehicles ever built.


[Read Article - Part 1](https://shoppress.dormanproducts.com/sergio-pininfarina-part-1/)


[Read Article - Part 2](https://shoppress.dormanproducts.com/sergio-pininfarina-part-2/)


### Ferdinand Porsche: Engineering the Shape of Speed by Evan Griffey


Few names carry as much weight in automotive history as Ferdinand Porsche. His career stretched from the earliest days of motoring through the rise of modern performance cars, encompassing innovations in motorsports, sports-car engineering, electric propulsion, and mass-market transportation. In this piece, we explore how one engineer’s ideas helped shape everything from early EVs to some of the most recognizable cars ever built.


[Read Article](https://shoppress.dormanproducts.com/ferdinand-porsche-automotive-paragons/)


Whether they were stylists, engineers, racers, entrepreneurs, or a combination of all four, each Automotive Paragon left a lasting mark on the vehicles we see (or dream about) every day.


We hope you’ve enjoyed reading these Automotive Paragons as much as we’ve enjoyed sharing their stories. Stay tuned to Shop Press for future installments as we continue exploring the people who helped shape automotive history.
